metadata.topology: TP1 x DP4 + EP4 on four Ascend950DT 9582 dies 0-3, one rank per die; one API server, four EngineCore/Worker pairs, world_size=4 HCCL, 96/384 routed experts per die; the node-local Engram DP group is 4
metadata.weights: measured per-die model load 78.88 GiB of 96 GiB; analytic body+vision weight plane 77.63 GiB after the 45.78 GiB Engram table plane is host-offloaded; 67.24 GiB of routed-expert weights are EP4-sharded (96 local experts/die)
metadata.engram: EngramConfig(cpu_offload=True, embedding_across_dp=False, dp_shared_memory=True); 94.42 GiB/rank host-resident, node-local DP group 4. The tables are not on the die; the per-token query/gather/broadcast remain device work and the CPU decode + H2D staging is a declared measurement gap, not a zero-cost path.
metadata.capacity: max_model_len=4096 is an explicit launch flag, not a 4-die hardware ceiling. Measured KV 2.81-2.82 GiB/die = 73,682-73,705 tokens = 17.99x at 4,096; the 4,096-token envelope is fully covered (p3072/o1024 = 4,096 admitted as-is, no o512 fallback). p4096/o1024 = 5,120 would be illegal. 16k/64k/128k were not attempted under this launch and are not claimed impossible.
metadata.kv_pool_source: measured engine lines: Available KV cache memory 2.81-2.82 GiB -> Maximum concurrency for 4,096 tokens per request 17.99x; 73,682-73,705 tokens; the pool is the admission capacity and the analytic compressed-row plan stays the live-row price
metadata.host: rack08os7 177.31.27.1, dies 0-3 only, 4 x Ascend950DT 9582, 96 GiB HBM each; ring 197.33.51.1 / enp39s0f0; port 18247; DP-RPC 13247
metadata.quantization: deepseek_v4_fp8: FP8 dynamic linears + MXFP4 group32 routed experts, BF16 KV, int8 indexer; norms, router, embedding, LM head, compressor runtime copies, vision and Engram gates stay BF16/FP32
metadata.graph: FULL CUDA graphs, capture sizes [1,2,4,8]; APC off; no MTP/speculative decode (speculative_config=None), so every engine step commits exactly one token (tokens/step=1.00)
metadata.measured_rows: The generic A5 BF16 physical operator calibration and the A5 die-5 MXFP4 dequant aggregate row are the measured inputs. The dequant row is an aggregate (160 calls, 13.1387 GB, 4.843778 ms) bound through runtime.metadata.mxfp4_dequant_row; it is not a per-op matrix, and a decode step whose dequant call count or byte budget differs is refused, not fitted. The exact MXFP4 grouped-expert GEMM, CSA2/MLA attention, Engram host lookup and DP4 c4 admission rows remain declared missing.
metadata.no_measured_latency: This case stores geometry, topology and capacity only. The measured four-cell medians live in cases/v41-a5-dp4.heldout.json and are never read by predict. The dequant row is an operator-level aggregate artifact (examples/artifacts/a5-mxfp4-dequant-row.json), not a serving-cell median.
metadata.kv_pool_source_detail: dp4-small serve.log worker init: 2.82 GiB/die, 73,705 tokens, 17.99x@4096
metadata.dp_step_admission_source: measured DP4 c4 completion events: the head request completes one prompt step alone, the three remaining requests complete in the next EP-lockstep wave, and the head first ITL equals that wave. Topology is one API server plus four EngineCore/Worker pairs over the four dies; EP4 spans the DP domain. Runtime scope: serve.log non-default args data_parallel_size=4 and max_num_batched_tokens=4096, [scheduler.py:288] Chunked prefill is enabled with max_num_batched_tokens=4096, and four EngineCore_DP0..3 processes with separate KV pools; vLLM v0.30.0 SchedulerConfig.max_num_batched_tokens is the single-iteration budget of each EngineCore scheduler, not a global pool. Raw: raw/matrix/p2048_o1024_c4.json and p3072_o1024_c4.json
